investigation.first_failed_game: red-1 stopped on a probe logging keyword error, then exposed the cutoff-navigation defect. Its raw evidence is retained; it has no finalized manifest and is excluded from all successful-game/replay counts.
investigation.hero_loss_recovery: Both colors lost their original hero in actual automatic combat, retained their town and live zero-reward decision, then hired and moved one replacement through native rules. The old restricted baseline has no hero hiring; this version permits native recovery.
investigation.natural_outcomes: Both controlled town-capture directions reached the standard day-8 natural outcome with complementary +1/-1 and verified native terminal barriers/replays. These scripts are diagnostics, never learner data or outcome-rate evidence.
investigation.unassisted_result: Two fixed-random-weight diagnostics each hit the 128-choice collection bound. Twenty of twenty-four move attempts had no known route; neither game built a Tavern. Capability availability does not establish strategic competence. No movement-range mask, scripted strategy, rule change or reward shaping was added to the policy.
